date.description: Required when dateMode is 'single'. Format: YYYYMMDD — e.g. 20240115.
date.title: Date (YYYYMMDD)

dateMode.description: Which date(s) to fetch. 'today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow' use the timezone field. 'single' requires the date field. 'range' requires startDate and endDate (max 30 days).
dateMode.title: Date Mode

endDate.description: Required when dateMode is 'range'. Format: YYYYMMDD. Maximum span is 30 days.
endDate.title: End Date (YYYYMMDD)

fetchDetails.description: Fetch per-game detail: leaders, odds, attendance, headlines. Makes one extra request per game.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch Game Details

leagues.description: One or more league codes to scrape. Supported: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, mls, wnba, ncaam, ncaaw, ncaaf, epl, laliga, ucl, bundesliga, seriea, ligue1, ligamx.
leagues.title: Leagues

maxItems.description: Maximum total game records to return across all leagues and dates.
maxItems.title: Max Items

startDate.description: Required when dateMode is 'range'. Format: YYYYMMDD.
startDate.title: Start Date (YYYYMMDD)

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for the dateLocal field and for resolving today/yesterday/tomorrow. E.g. America/New_York, Europe/London.
timezone.title: Timezone
